terminus.finding: Wang Xing-zhi's 2016 Nuannuan field note observes that public land and planning constraints kept Guogang outside ordinary commercial redevelopment; the same non-development may have preserved old buildings, walkable everyday relations and conditions for long-running community organizing. The note also stresses that students can remain detached from 'other people's community' despite formal teaching interventions.
terminus.generated: FRICTION-AS-HABITAT MODEL: a barrier can simultaneously block one action set and preserve the substrate for another. Therefore 'lowering thresholds' is not monotonically beneficial: removing friction may increase access while destroying slow relations, local memory or low-rent organizational habitat. The analytical unit should be threshold + what it excludes + what its persistence shelters.
